gen-gf-underdog-gf-pontano-sans: Underdog draws every curve in one unbroken line, with a horseshoe c. Pontano Sans follows as a plain sans, its terminals wide open, so the heading's single thread gives way to something looser.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-pt-sans: Underdog cuts its letters like ribbon of constant width, with a big horseshoe c at the front of the line. PT Sans keeps pace, approachable and open.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-quattrocento-sans: Underdog moves with a quiet, level beat and no weight accents. It handles the loud display work, while Quattrocento Sans keeps its gaps distinct so c never slides into o.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-red-hat-text: Chunky, curvy and a bit cheeky. Red Hat Text follows in a plain sans with the line weight of a technical drawing pen, so Underdog's horseshoe curves sit beside something tidy and precise.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-reddit-sans: Underdog builds each letter from one width of stroke, with a c opened wide like a horseshoe. Reddit Sans, a plain sans, brings its wide-gapped e and steady thickness to the paragraphs, where Underdog would be too loud.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-rethink-sans: Underdog opens with a horseshoe c and no shift in weight anywhere along its curves. Rethink Sans then takes over the text, its generous openings staying put at every weight, so the headline's boldness has somewhere easy to land.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-roboto-flex: Roboto Flex has a wide slot between the c's two ends, which gives its sans-serif text a friendly, modern face. Roboto Flex is the one to adjust in size, nudging it up until the text feels comfortable beside Underdog.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-ruluko: Ruluko reads as a sans-serif with broad, open counters on c and s, approachable and clean. Underdog's lines have no pressure swells to slow the eye, which is the pair's real hook.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-sansation: A bent-wire sign look, constant in thickness. Sansation sits below as a plain sans where curves turn in without ink pooling, which gives Underdog's loud outlines a smooth, easygoing partner.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-sarala: Sarala reads as a plain sans with distinct gaps in c, e and s, and a thickness like neon glass tubing. Underdog is best at commanding display lettering, while Sarala is best at staying friendly.
